overview_description.description: Blend is a digital lending platform that supports and simplifies applications for mortgages, consumer loans, and deposit accounts.The company helps lenders streamline the customer journey for any banking product from application to close. Its Digital Lending Platform is utilized by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 285 other leading financial institutions to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deepen customer relationships. The company enables customers to process more than $4 billion in mortgages and consumer loans per day, helping millions of consumers get into homes and gain access to the capital they need to lead better lives. Erin Collard, Eugene Marinelli, Nima Ghamsari, and Rosco Hill headquartered the company in San Francisco, California in 2012.

about_short_description.short_description: Blend is a digital lending platform that facilitates the entire lending process, from application to underwriting to closing.

product.name: Blend Platform
product.description: A digital origination platform for mortgage lending, consumer lending, and deposit account opening, supporting workflows from application through closing or account funding.

product.name: Blend Home Lending Suite
product.description: A suite for digital mortgage and home lending origination, verification, lender workflow management, closing, refinancing, and home equity lending.

product.name: Blend Consumer Banking Suite
product.description: A digital account-opening and consumer-lending suite that helps financial institutions originate deposit accounts and consumer loans through connected application and cross-sell workflows.

product.name: Blend Intelligent Origination
product.description: An intelligent origination capability that uses automation and AI to streamline application review, verification, underwriting-related tasks, and follow-up across lending workflows.

product.name: Blend Autopilot
product.description: An AI agent for mortgage origination that automates loan-origination reviews and related follow-up, including review completion reported by Blend in approximately 15 seconds.

product.name: Rapid Home Equity
product.description: A digital home equity lending solution with pre-filled applications, automated verification and decisioning, offer exploration, debt-consolidation tools, and hybrid or remote online closing.
